narrative.overview: A deep Egyptian Blue field, calm Stone Blue structure, and one exotic pink signal that lights up only for what matters. One modern grotesk in big sentence-case headlines. Panels are Liquid Glass over a few very faint drifting lights; motion is soft and slow.
keyCharacteristics: Dark Egyptian Blue for everyone; there is no light theme.
Exotic Pink is the only warm colour and always means near you, new or act now.
Liquid Glass panels over faint drifting light.
Soft motion only: slow light drift, gentle fade-ups, a sliding filter highlight, a sheen on pink buttons.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Pink appears only on what someone should act on or notice.

rules.name: The Three Colours Rule
rules.body: Egyptian Blue, Stone Blue and Exotic Pink, plus Frost for text. No fourth hue, no gradients.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Headlines, buttons and navigation are sentence case.

rules.name: The Glass Over Light Rule
rules.body: Glass always sits over the faint drifting lights; never glass on glass, never body text over the lights outside a panel.

dos: Do keep the page Egyptian Blue for everyone.
Do use Exotic Pink only for near you, new, on sale, primary actions and focus.
Do put Egyptian Blue text on pink fills.
Do write headlines, buttons and navigation in sentence case.
Do mark near-you gigs with shape as well as colour.
donts: Don't use photos, illustrations, a fourth colour or decorative gradients (the faint background lights and the glass sheen are the only ones).
Don't put white text on Exotic Pink.
Don't stack glass on glass or let the background lights get bright enough to cut body-text contrast.
Don't use all-caps for headlines or buttons.
